prompt.text:
Implement `searchNotes(notes, phrase)` and `findTag(tags, name)`. A note is a plain object with string `title` and `body` fields and an optional boolean `archived` field. `searchNotes` validates every note, trims and case-folds `phrase`, and returns new shallow copies of non-archived notes whose title or body contains the normalized phrase. Results retain input order; an empty normalized phrase returns an empty array. A tag is a plain object with string `name` and `description` fields. `findTag` performs a trimmed, case-insensitive exact-name match and returns a shallow copy of the first match or `null`; an empty normalized name returns `null`. Throw `TypeError` for non-array collections, non-string queries, or malformed records. Neither function may mutate its inputs. Export exactly `{ searchNotes, findTag }` using CommonJS.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
